title: Guided reading: Luke 5:20
subtitle: Read faith language and a declaration.
overview: Luke 5:20 repeats the same basic event with a different discourse setting. Notice how the aorist participle supplies the basis for the direct address.
Compare rather than harmonize: repeated grammar can help you see each author’s wording and emphasis.

items.grc: καὶ ἰδὼν τὴν πίστιν αὐτῶν εἶπεν.
items.en: And seeing their faith, he said.

items.grc: ἄνθρωπε, ἀφέωνταί σοι αἱ ἁμαρτίαι σου.
items.en: Man, your sins have been forgiven.
